rationale.conceptual: Standard MD simulation method with a well-documented force field; the analysis (peak tracking in PDFs) is an established technique. No novel algorithms or derivations, just careful application of known methods to a specific system.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: generating input files for 25+ state points, running NPT equilibration then NVE production, computing O-O g(r) from trajectories, extracting multiple peak positions and heights, and applying a conditional crossover criterion. About 4-5 interdependent stages requiring orchestration, though no external data fetching or complex tooling.

Implementation involves a multi-stage pipeline (MD setup, equilibration, production, post-processing) for multiple state points, though the engineering is routine for computational science. Resource demands are modest: ~32k water molecules, short simulation times, no GPU needed.
